name: @three-studio/desktop
//desktopName: Not an npm field. Electron reads it as the Linux app_id and sets WM_CLASS from it; electron-builder matches the .desktop filename and StartupWMClass to it when linux.syncDesktopName is on. Without it the two disagree and a running window is not associated with its launcher entry, so it shows a generic icon.
description: Electron shell. Stays CommonJS: sandboxed preload scripts cannot be ESM.
//homepage: electron-builder reads metadata from this file, not from the workspace root, and the AppImage target refuses to build without a homepage. `author` fills the deb maintainer and silences a warning on every packaging run.
author: Three Studio contributors <three-studio@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.//icons: Regenerates the committed icon PNGs from build/icon.svg, so they stay reproducible rather than being nine opaque binaries. macOS needs different artwork from the other two — see the header of scripts/make-icons.sh. Author-side tool: needs librsvg (brew install librsvg), never runs in CI, which reads the committed PNGs.

//dependencies: esbuild is a runtime dependency, not a build tool here: the app compiles user scripts while it runs. Being a dependency keeps electron-vite from bundling it, which matters because its JS API locates a native binary by a path relative to its own package.
